this_court: adopts the check-clearance rule, which the opinion says matches the only two circuits to address it, so there is no split
quote: Only two circuits have answered the question before us: whether the check-receipt date or the check-clearance date triggers the statute of limitations under § 6532(b).
cite: United States v. Jeffrey Page, 116 F.4th 822 (9th Cir. 2024)
